CASE STUDY · MOBILE APP · iOS & ANDROID

Application redesign for Staff.am

How I turned an outdated, inconsistent mobile app into a clear, modern experience that feels like the Staff.am website and follows iOS and Android standards.

ROLEUX/UI Designer
DURATION1 month, 1 week
PLATFORMSiOS · Android
TOOLSFigma · ChatGPT · Google Docs
Profile 80% complete
Upload resume
Actively searching

01 · OVERVIEW

An app users found hard to use

Staff.am is a career platform that connects employers and job seekers in Armenia. The previous version of the mobile app looked outdated and felt inconsistent next to the website.

Users found it difficult to navigate, apply for jobs and manage their profiles. My focus was on usability, a modern interface, and aligning each platform with its own design standards.

1

Outdated interface

The visual style and components felt dated.

2

Inconsistent with the website

The app and the web looked like different products.

3

Hard to navigate, apply and manage a profile

Core tasks took more effort than they should.

05 · GOALS

06 · PERSONA

Meet Aram, who looks for roles on the move

AH

Aram Hayrapetyan

Front-End Developer

Age
29
Location
Yerevan, Armenia
Detail-oriented and analyticalPerfectionist about his profileGoal-driven and proactive

About

Aram is a passionate front-end developer at a mid-sized tech company, always open to opportunities that help him grow. He checks Staff.am for roles that match his skills, mostly from his phone during short breaks or while commuting, so speed, clarity and usability are crucial.

PAIN POINTS
  • The profile editing flow is confusing, with too many steps for basic updates
  • No way to download or replace documents
  • Inconsistent visual hierarchy makes sections hard to find
  • The mobile version lacks key features of the website
GOALS
  • Update and manage his CV easily from mobile
  • A clear, editable structure for skills, experience and projects
  • Upload, preview and organise additional CVs
  • Synchronise mobile and web without inconsistencies

Key flows, one problem at a time

09 · iOS & ANDROID

Two platforms, one brand

The visual style follows iOS and Android guidelines, using platform-specific components while keeping Staff.am’s branding, so the experience feels familiar on both.

iOS
ANDROID

iOS

Dates are picked in a bottom sheet with scrolling wheels, the pattern iOS users already know.

Android

Dates are picked in a centred dialog with Cancel and Confirm, and the system navigation bar stays visible.

10 · STYLE CARD

One consistent, familiar experience

The visual style of the redesign was created from iOS and Android guidelines, using platform-specific components while maintaining the original Staff.am branding and style.

The result is a consistent, intuitive and familiar experience across both platforms.
